Problem Statement:
Given a string S, generate all possible permutations of the characters in the string using recursion and backtracking. Each permutation should be unique. Print the permutations in lexicographical order. 
Input Description:
- A single line containing the string S. 
Output Description:
- Each line contains one permutation of the string S. 
Sample Input:
abc 
Sample Output:
abc
acb
bac
bca
cab
cba 
Explanation:
All possible unique permutations of the string "abc" are printed in lexicographical order.
